---

## 2. Core Technical Capabilities

### 2.1 Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD)
PCE Nigeria is Africa's foremost contractor for large-diameter, long-distance trenchless river, road, and environmental crossings.
- Fleet Capability: 1,200-tonne & 500-tonne pullback capacity HDD drilling rigs.
- Max Diameter Capability: Up to 48-inch steel gas and oil pipelines.
- Record Length: Over 2,293 meters in a single continuous drill section (Raoyang River HDD crossing).
- Key Focus Areas: Complex geology crossings, riverbed scour protection, environmental preservation.

### 2.2 52km Pipeline EPC Construction
Turnkey Engineering, Procurement, and Construction services for cross-country and swamp pipeline infrastructure.
- Scope: Route survey, right-of-way clearing, trenching, automatic & semi-automatic pipe welding, Non-Destructive Testing (NDT), field joint coating, hydrotesting, pre-commissioning, and nitrogen purging.

### 2.3 Buried Pipeline Detection System (BPDS)
Patented 3D electromagnetic survey technology for locating deeply buried pipelines under rivers and thick overburdens.
- Measurement Parameters: 3D location (X, Y, Z coordinates), exact depth measurement, structural trajectory mapping.
- Applications: Subsea/riverbed pipeline verification, anti-clash surveys, integrity assessments.

### 2.4 Equipment Fleet & Maintenance Yard
Centralized heavy machinery yard providing complete technical support.
- Equipment Inventory: Heavy HDD rigs, high-pressure mud pumps (triplex/duplex), mud recycling solids control units, desanders, desilters, centrifuges, excavators, pipe side-booms, bentonite mixing hoppers, and electronic steering tool guidance systems.

---

## 3. Product Catalog: Drilling Fluid Additives & Lantic Bentonite

### 3.1 BRSBENT SQ (Lantic Bentonite)
- Product Name: BRSBENT SQ Activated Bentonite
- Brand / Origin: Lantic / Premium Natural Sodium Bentonite
- Standard Compliance: API Spec 13A / OCMA
- Applications: Horizontal Directional Drilling (HDD), slurry shield TBMs, diaphragm walls, and water well drilling.
- Key Benefits: Fast hydration, high viscosity yield, superior wall cake creation, low fluid loss, and suspension of dense drill cuttings.

### 3.2 BRSCMC (Carboxymethyl Cellulose)
- Product Name: BRSCMC Technical Grade CMC
- Function: Fluid loss reducer and viscosifier for water-based mud systems.
- Benefits: Minimizes filtrate loss into permeable sand formations, encapsulates shale cuttings, and resists thermal degradation.

### 3.3 BRSMMH (Mixed Metal Hydroxide)
- Product Name: BRSMMH Viscosifier
- Function: Inorganic liquid/powder additive for high yield point to plastic viscosity (YP/PV) ratio muds.
- Benefits: Creates extreme shear-thinning thixotropic gel structures for flawless cuttings transport in coarse gravel and cobble.

### 3.4 BRSVR (Clay Viscosity Reducer)
- Product Name: BRSVR Dispersant
- Function: Clay stripper, thinner, and deflocculant.
- Benefits: Prevents bit balling when drilling through reactive Gumbo clays, reduces torque and drag, and maintains pumpable mud weights.

### 3.5 BRSXTG (Xanthan Gum Biopolymer)
- Product Name: BRSXTG Biopolymer
- Function: High-purity biopolymer viscosifier.
- Benefits: Exceptional carry capacity at low shear rates, stable across wide pH and salinity ranges.

---

## 4. Key Landmark Projects

### 4.1 Ajaokuta-Kaduna-Kano (AKK) River Niger HDD Crossing
- Client / Pipeline: AKK 48-Inch Gas Pipeline Project
- Scope: Design, pilot hole drilling, multi-stage reaming, and pipe pullback for 48" gas pipeline across the River Niger.
- Impact: Strategic national gas backbone project supplying power and industrial hubs in Northern Nigeria.

### 4.2 Obiafu-Obrikom-Oben (OB3) River Niger HDD Crossing
- Client / Pipeline: OB3 Gas Interconnect Pipeline
- Scope: 48-inch pipeline HDD river crossing under high current riverbed conditions.
- Impact: Critical gas delivery link connecting Eastern gas fields to Western industrial zones.

### 4.3 52km Pipeline EPC Project
- Scope: End-to-end EPC pipeline installation across challenging swamp and riverine terrain.
